notes.title: Beta 2.0 Released! Mizuki’s Story Completed
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185213/23b40663dc9b65250e229c509e399527b38fcc25.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185213/582a0fe50870ab50e05afa3cf1c41aec51da11de.png[/img][/url]We’ve officially moved out of Alpha and into Beta 2.0! The story of Mizuki is now fully completed, featuring three possible endings: two Bad Ends and one True End — can you uncover the real ending? There are still a few bugs being worked on, but the main goal was to deliver a complete and emotional storyline.

Next up: we shift our focus to Fritz’s story – Part 2.
Thanks to everyone who's been playing and supporting the development! 🚀
